CustomField.description: Set by AI Assist on a user message that was sent while the org-wide cap on messages in flight was reached. The message stays Queued and is started when a place is free, or failed as Service Busy when none is within a few minutes.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked while the message waits for a free place under the org-wide cap. Set automatically.
CustomField.label: Is Awaiting Capacity
